correction: The SDDM probe reported autologin false only for an active User key in /etc/sddm.conf [Autologin], but SDDM reads that file after /etc/sddm.conf.d, so an active Session or Relogin key there also wins over the drop-in; autologin is now false for any of User, Session and Relogin in that section, and README and ADR-0016 state the same rule.
